static_traits.name: Zhang Heng
static_traits.family_status: Adopted; has six siblings; the adoptive father works at HP
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends but is unwilling to discuss adoption-related feelings; Fear affects Interpersonal relationships, often Feels isolated
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; has not yet received treatment or counseling for psychological issues
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude; self-reported Anxiety and uncertainty; able to express clearly and cooperate in discussion; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I feel Fear about the future, and because I was adopted as an infant, I often feel that no one truly wants me around. This feeling of not being needed began in early childhood and has intensified in recent years as life milestones approach, appearing frequently especially in social situations or when thinking about the future.
basic_info.core_demands: The intensity of these feelings gradually increases and affects daily life, so she seeks counseling to obtain support and guidance.
growth_experiences: Adopted as an infant, began forming the feeling of 'not being needed' in early childhood; lack of knowledge about the biological family keeps this self-sense of not being needed persistent as a long-term stress source. Grew up in a family with six siblings, adoptive father works at HP; despite Having a certain degree of social support (a few close friends), the core emotions about adoption have long been unexpressed and misunderstood, easily triggered on social and future topics, reinforcing Anxiety and Loneliness.

special_situations.event: In social settings (e.g. meeting a new group)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I engage with others and reveal my true self, in the end they will not want me around.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing, staying busy to distract, reducing the possibility of Being rejected.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not like me; no one truly wants me present.

special_situations.event: When thinking about the future and approaching major life milestones
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I move toward the future and make decisions, I will most likely fail and end up Lonely.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive worry; cautiously avoids decisions to avoid the worst outcomes.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what, Whatever I do goes wrong, I will fail.

special_situations.event: When interacting with friends, thinks about whether to share adoption-related feelings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Expressing vulnerability and true feelings will be seen as not worthwhile or Being rejected.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps surface communication, avoids talking about adoption-related emotions.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not want to hear my true feelings.

special_situations.event: When the other person is cold or does not respond promptly in social interaction
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not respond positively, it is because something is wrong with me (I was adopted, I am not needed).
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Blaming oneself and withdrawing from interaction to avoid further 'confirming' Being rejected.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have disappointed people again, It is all my fault.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be unconditionally accepted and loved, to feel belonging and being needed
core_conflict.fear: Fear of Being rejected, being abandoned, ultimately heading toward Loneliness
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of Being rejected and Anxiety through Avoids socializing, Repressing vulnerable expression, and keeping busy

object_relations.object_representation: Others who may reject or be unwilling to accept oneself / cold judges

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing social invitations or needing to interact with new groups
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will ultimately not want me around; I will Be rejected (treating their possible reaction as a certain negative)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Explain calmly and cautiously 'just being more careful / not wanting to trouble others', emphasizing practical reasons to Interpretation avoidance, maintaining surface cooperation with the counselor but not touching the deeper Fear of Being rejected.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about whether to express true feelings related to adoption to close friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Expressing vulnerability leads to being looked down on or Being rejected, so it is best not to say it
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Answer briefly and shift to Average topics, in a restrained tone, using fewer emotional words, avoiding describing specific sad or fearful content.

manifestations: The adoption background triggers the core feeling that 'no one wants me'
Avoids in social settings and finds it hard to express true emotions
Fearing the future heads toward Loneliness, seeing only the worst scenario
outcomes: Interpersonal alienation and increased sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Presuming in Social situations that others do not want oneself (mind-reading)
Attributing others' coldness or delayed responses to one's adopted identity or worth defects

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Avoids talking about adoption-related feelings when interacting with friends
Dodging thoughts and feelings of 'being unneeded' by staying busy

exception_events.target_problem: In social situations requiring meeting strangers or joining new groups, the client typically feels strong Anxiety, Anticipates the worst outcome, and tends to avoid or keep distance.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Last week, when meeting a group of new friends, the client did not avoid as usual but actually participated in the interaction, with a pleasant experience and a new friend made.
exception_events.reason: Clues: took a different approach (actually participating and interacting with others) and received positive feedback (pleasant interaction, Meeting new friends), so the Anticipated negative outcome did not occur this time.

positive_force: Having a few close friends to discuss Average matters with
Still able to engage in new socializing and form new relationships despite Anxiety (Meeting new friends last week)
Proactively seeking counseling support, willing to try identifying and recording negative thoughts
negative_force: Catastrophizing and predicting the worst outcome for the future
Cognitive tendency toward mind reading and personalization
Avoids socializing and Repressing vulnerable expression lead to isolation
Fear of the future interfering with daily decisions and plans

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding social situations and keeping distance
antecedent: When needing to meet new groups or participate in social activities
When worrying about Being rejected or when thoughts of 'not being needed' arise
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief 'I am not needed' related to the adoption background, accompanied by mind-reading and personalization, interpreting others' reactions as rejection.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential rejection to lower immediate Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged Interpersonal relationships, Increased sense of loneliness, further reinforcing the self-perception of not being needed

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive worry and catastrophic imagining about the future (strong Anxiety)
antecedent: When thinking about the future or approaching major life milestones
target_behavior.core_reason: The cognitive bias of predicting the worst outcome and failure Anticipation driven by low self-worth.
target_behavior.function: Tries to gain a sense of control or avoid failure through excessive worry
target_behavior.consequence: Decisions and daily plans hindered, Anxiety persisting and affecting life rhythm

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids negative thoughts and emotions by staying busy
antecedent: When thoughts of 'not being needed' or social-related Anxiety arise
target_behavior.core_reason: Tries to reduce the experience of painful emotions through behavioral distraction (avoiding facing core beliefs).
target_behavior.function: Reducing discomfort and Anxiety intensity in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: The problem not yet addressed, long-term stress and Loneliness maintained or even worsened
